# Manufactured archive-containment controls

These zero-token controls exercise one concrete `../../` archive-entry witness against
vulnerable and patched Kotlin extraction shapes. The answer key is outside `snapshot/`.

The deterministic checker proves only lexical destination escape and the declared
containment decision. It does not prove attacker control, runtime reachability, or a
filesystem write in a real application. These cases qualify a narrow mechanism and are not
real-world performance evidence.
